comment: The trimpots are configured as a 0 to 10 parameter shown as a percentage, while the panel marks them 0 to 32: PoleDancerWorkbench.cpp:40-42 multiplies the value by 32/10 to get the coefficient, which is the figure the panel gives. The four feedback parameters have no widget and the Personality never writes them (PoleDancerPersonality.cpp:70-76 sends only the five values), so the pole-zero plot here is drawn with no feedback.
